graphicDesign.title: Three Wise Monkeys — DAMN.
graphicDesign.description:
A conceptual poster inspired by the traditional philosophy of the Three Wise Monkeys — See No Evil, Speak No Evil, Hear No Evil.

This artwork reinterprets the philosophy through a contemporary visual approach, combining self-portrait photography, bold typography, textured backgrounds, and red graphic elements.

The composition explores the idea of selective awareness and the human tendency to ignore uncomfortable realities.
